//: The repository tooling: scripts, e2e tests and the config files at the root (the Vite and Vitest configs belong to tsconfig.app.json). Node runs the TypeScript scripts directly. Only the root config files (ESLint, lint-staged, PostCSS, Stylelint) are JavaScript, because their tools load them as such; `allowJs` and `checkJs` type-check those through their JSDoc. Used by `tsc -b` and by ESLint's type-aware rules.
